title: Giant Magellan eastern technical support building
visualBrief: Whole independent original 4-corner east building at the inferred GMTtechnical SS1 support site. Exact room/function/floor census and historical surface detail are estimates. Other buildings, support sites and actual summit works remain separate; no operating-enclosure or whole-project proxy. Full original Google-via-OvertureWKB outline fixed before own source field/floor/sections. 1 qualified original2023height observations, median4m; learned relative height, not survey. Provider score is not a probability. Every appearance image unused after Qualla-first screening. Individual function, room census, 1 storeys, all door/window positions, shallow pitched metal roof, white panel finish and minor fittings are original visualization estimates. The precise68-room/24-room/operator-named identity is not assigned from size or a photograph. SS1 membership is inferred from the published relative site location and original spatial cluster. Original Google full source outline and 1 original2023 qualified height observations, median4m retained. Relative heights are learned effective4m estimates, not a physical survey or floor census. At least3m height/10m horizontal/15degree yaw allowances are nominal estimates, not measured confidence bounds; no Chile-specific model performance claimed. Original low/upper native corner source grade selected a first-pass floor1.2335m and foundation bottom-1.6056m before geometry. This is a nominal terrace/retaining-base reconstruction from coarse source ground, not an observed historic floor. The actual engineered cut/fill and exact ground datum are unavailable. Own original256m129x129source field and rawtiles frozen before floors/mainsections. No masking, flattening, ground cutout, render-based height change, relocation or source-field/frame refit. Other buildings, the full personnel/technical sites, actual summit construction and the unbuilt telescope/enclosure remain separate scope. This whole independent support body is not a whole-project proxy. Approximate2023appearance based on original numerical observations and later written support-site operational status. Every source photograph/diagram/plan/map image/image-derived description unused; the one Qualla metadata conflict is excluded with all appearance references.
